title: Reading Drill — Water for the Courtyard Trees
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Water for the Courtyard Trees
passages.body:
**A** A small business park asked its gardener to reduce water use during summer. The gardener recorded the soil condition beneath each tree using a long probe, rather than judging by the colour of the surface.

**B** Most trees needed less frequent watering than expected. However, the ground by a busy walkway had become compacted, so water drained sideways before reaching the roots. A narrow strip of that soil was loosened.

**C** The gardener also moved the watering times to the early morning. If rain was forecast, an assistant checked the weather station and skipped the scheduled session when conditions made it unnecessary.
